'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***[[Israeli attack on Ramyah UNIFIL post]]
****Two [[Israel Defense Forces]] [[Merkava]] tanks forcibly enter a [[UNIFIL]] base in [[Ramyah]], [[Bint Jbeil District]], [[Lebanon]]. The tanks fire rounds at the base, injuring fifteen [[UN peacekeeping|United Nations peacekeeper]]s. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwylekwngz8o (BBC News)]
***[[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s destroy an [[Ottoman Empire|Ottoman]]-era market in [[Nabatieh]], [[Lebanon]], killing at least one person and injuring four others. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-lebanon-hezbollah-news-10-13-2024-a8cd5df3e2bb4ab08405a78251244bb2 (AP)]
**[[2024 Hezbollah drone strike on Binyamina]]
***Four [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] are killed and 61 others are injured in a [[Hezbollah]] [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] on [[Binyamina-Giv'at Ada]], [[Israel]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-four-soldiers-killed-51-wounded-in-hezbollah-drone-strike-near-binyamina/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[United States support for Israel in the Gaza war]]
***[[United States]] [[United States Secretary of Defense|Secretary of Defense]] [[Lloyd Austin]] authorizes the deployment of a [[Terminal High Altitude Area Defense]] [[missile defense]] system to [[Israel]] to help boost the country's air defences. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/13/us-deploying-thaad-missile-defence-system-troops-to-israel (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-send-anti-missile-system-israel-says-pentagon-2024-10-13/ (Reuters)]
**An Israeli attack on a school used to shelter [[internally displaced people|displaced]] [[Palestinian]]s kills at least 22 people, including fifteen children, in the [[Nuseirat refugee camp]] in northern [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5y8zj8qrn5o (BBC News)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Foreign involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] states that [[Korean People's Army|North Korean troops]] have been deployed to [[Ukraine]] to fight alongside the [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian military]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/zelenskiy-says-north-koreans-fighting-with-russians-ukraine-2024-10-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]], [[October 2024 Sudan airstrikes]] 
***At least 23 people are killed and 40 others are injured in a [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] airstrike on a marketplace in an area of [[Khartoum]], [[Sudan]], currently controlled by the [[Rapid Support Forces]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/sudan-over-20-killed-in-army-strike-on-khartoum-rescuers/a-70481967 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Lithuanian parliamentary election]]
**Lithuanians vote in the first round of elections to elect the 141 members of the [[Seimas]]. [https://apnews.com/article/lithuania-elections-parliament-3ec44ad544ae11cf05b1b112175ef93b (AP)]
*[[2024 Macanese Chief Executive election]]
**[[Sam Hou Fai]] is elected as the new [[Chief Executive of Macau]] by the Election Committee, succeeding [[Ho Iat Seng]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/sam-hou-fai-elected-chief-executive-designate-macau-2024-10-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Starship flight test 5]]
**[[SpaceX]] completes its fifth test flight of the [[SpaceX Starship (spacecraft)|Starship]] spacecraft, successfully catching the [[booster (rocketry)|rocket booster]] with the arms of the [[launch tower]] at [[SpaceX Starbase|Starbase]] in [[Texas]], [[United States]], and with the spacecraft landing in the [[Indian Ocean]]. [https://www.space.com/news/live/spacex-starship-missions-updates (Space.com)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2024/10/13/spacex-starship-rocket-launch-flight-5-booster-catch-attempt.html (CNBC)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Chicago Marathon]]
**[[Kenya|Kenyan]] runner [[Ruth Chepng'etich]] runs 2:09:56 to break the world record for women's marathon by 1 minute and 57 seconds at the [[Chicago Marathon]]. [https://apnews.com/article/chicago-marathon-ruth-chepngetich-world-record-a0ac28b89f4763cc8150ae301e369176 (AP)]
